summary: AI-powered thumbnail creation and enhancement tool with three main features: generate thumbnails from text prompts, enhance uploaded thumbnails, and create thumbnails based on video links with customization options
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Hero section background image with abstract creative design elements in vibrant colors (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Placeholder thumbnail image showing a grid layout for the gallery view (placeholder-thumbnail.dim_400x300.png)
- Icon for text prompt generation feature, representing AI creativity (icon-prompt.dim_128x128.png)
- Icon for upload feature, representing file upload action (icon-upload.dim_128x128.png)
- Icon for video link feature, representing video to thumbnail conversion (icon-video-link.dim_128x128.png)

existing_features.title: Create a text input interface where users can enter a text prompt to generate a thumbnail image using AI
Create an upload interface where users can upload their own thumbnail images for enhancement
Create an input interface where users can paste a video link to generate a similar thumbnail
Create an editor interface with customization options where users can modify generated thumbnails according to their preferences
Design a modern, creative visual theme with bold, vibrant colors and clean typography that emphasizes creativity and visual media, consistently applied across all pages and components

new_feature_requests.summary: Generate thumbnails from text prompts using AI
Implement backend functionality to generate thumbnail images from text prompts
Implement backend functionality to enhance uploaded thumbnail images to improve their quality and visual appeal
Implement backend functionality to analyze video links and generate similar thumbnails based on the video content
Implement backend support for applying user customizations to thumbnails and returning the modified versions
